items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser keeps skin comfortable while it is still settling after isotretinoin.
A ceramide moisturizer supports the skin barrier and helps with the moisture level shown in your scan.
A mineral SPF 50 is a gentle daily way to protect the look of marks from getting darker.

response.routine_note: I've left out the 30% peel and other strong exfoliants, scrubs and retinoids because you stopped isotretinoin under six months ago, so please ask your dermatologist when peels would be suitable for you. Meanwhile, cleanse and moisturize morning and night and apply the SPF every morning.
